# Cardify, cardify.om
# Generated by gen_robots.py. Every group below carries the SAME rule
# set, because a named group does not inherit the wildcard group's
# rules. Asserted per (agent, path) by robots_gate.py.
# Allow: /company/register.php is LONGER than Disallow: /company/, so it
# wins Google's longest-match rule. It is the primary signup CTA, linked 13
# times from the home page, and the free-tier Offer in the home page's
# SoftwareApplication JSON-LD points at /get-started, which is not under
# /company/ at all. Do not drop either half.
